text:
Anya: Quick fun question — invent a new custom Slack reaction emoji (name + what it means). Go!
Matt: :brain-bulb-party: "brain-bulb" — when someone posts a ridiculous clever workaround
Jordan: :sip-milkshake: "energy-sip" — for when code finally compiles after 4 tries
Lee: :ghost-merge: "ghost-merge" — merger that happened without conflicts (rare)
Samira: :tiny-hero: "tiny-hero" — shoutout for the small fix that saved the day
Matt: Also :panic-button: — "panic-button" but used ironically when a minor incident looks dramatic
Jordan: @Anya ooh can we get :ghost-merge: made?
EmojiBot: Heads-up — made an emoji suggestion thread in #design: https://example.com/emoji-submissions :sparkles:
Lee: vote: :tiny-hero: :+1:
Samira: I want :coffee-wave: "coffee-wave" — a wave for someone bringing snacks to the office ☕️
Anya: Loving these. I'll collect and maybe we'll put 3 in the org pack. :sparkles:
